recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-7493; future detailed SNOMED CT external terminology wording should be handled in THO, not by restoring the removed core page.
issue_request: FHIR-7493 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Vocabulary change request asking that a poorly structured sentence on the SNOMED implicit value set URL be rewritten and that SNOMED be capitalized consistently.
initial_application: The issue was applied in SVN revision 5684, mirrored as git commit df5d1d05df20bfa0e92664cde778bc4df1f14a61 (#7493 - reorg sentence), which rewrote source/snomedct.html into a clearer two-part SNOMED CT implicit value set URL description.
additional_context: FHIR-35933 later removed the Using SNOMED CT with FHIR page from the core build as part of moving external-code-system guidance to HL7 Terminology. The current active source/hierarchy.xml includes source/terminologies-systems.html and source/snomedct-usage.html; the Code Systems page now points authoritative external terminology guidance to THO and links SNOMED CT to the THO Using SNOMED CT with HL7 Standards page.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The originally reported wording is not present in current source, the historical fix is visible in git history, and current build-scoped core source uses SNOMED CT capitalization while delegating detailed external terminology guidance to THO.

related_jiras.note: Moved Using X/external code system pages, including SNOMED CT, from FHIR core to THO and explains why source/snomedct.html is no longer in the current build.
